semantics.canonical_records: R4 canonical_captures are settled/canonical readiness records.
semantics.literal_loading_text: Literal Loading.... evidence is retained separately from loading_nodes and loading boolean.
semantics.r5_runtime_ready_metric: R5 material_ready_failure is preserved exactly; it is not a severity or Product-defect verdict.
semantics.stress_records: R4 stress_diagnostics and R5 geometry/loading rows are stress/holdout probe states.
